#!/bin/sh
# Launch argv for #152's adjudicator on target-A, retained verbatim (a #199 gap the closeout named).
cd "<work>" || exit 2
date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > dispatched_at.txt
timeout 3600 claude -p --session-id "deb66501-9404-4af9-8bda-b9e3e03a4047" \
  --model claude-sonnet-5 --effort high --restricted \
  --tools "Bash,Read,Write,Edit,Glob,Grep" \
  --allowedTools "Write" "Edit" "Bash(git:*)" "Bash(go:*)" "Bash(cargo:*)" "Bash(python3:*)" "Bash(cat:*)" "Bash(ls:*)" "Bash(head:*)" "Bash(tail:*)" "Bash(wc:*)" "Bash(sed:*)" "Bash(grep:*)" "Bash(find:*)" "Bash(diff:*)" \
  --add-dir "<clone>" --add-dir "<inputs>" \
  --permission-prompts none --max-budget-usd 2.50 --output-format json \
  "$(cat prompt.md)" < /dev/null > result.json 2> stderr.log
echo "exit $?" > exit.txt
date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > finished_at.txt
note: the launch argv verbatim, with the work, clone, inputs and cache paths masked because a clone directory is named after its target; the unmasked script is in sealed/; the exported build-cache environment lines are omitted because they name the toolchain
